knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Investigating a large difference is the step the lesson requires: check whether the change points are right and adjust the estimate or the method. Cutting gloves below the protection rule (option 0) and ignoring the gap (option 2) are both ruled out.

The lesson says expired items must not be used and over-stock is avoided, so expiry dates are checked at each stock check. Tidiness (option 0) and a new label requirement (option 2) are not the reasons.
The reorder section says to set a reorder level for each consumable so that the team does not run out during a job.

practicalCriteria: Learner estimates consumables for a supplied job from the task map and records the basis of the estimate.
Learner compares a supplied set of usage figures with the estimate, identifies a cause for the largest difference and proposes an adjustment.
Learner checks expiry dates in a supplied stock register and moves older stock forward.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Consumables estimate and stock register with reorder levels and expiry checks
stopWorkCriteria: Learner reduces gloves or cloths below the number the zone and protection rules need
